svg.text: Weekly Report Generator & Team Dashboard — entity relationship diagram
Enum columns (stored as VARCHAR(20), validated by the application)
Unique constraints: (user_id, week_start) on reports — one report per user per week · (report_id, version_number) on report_versions
reports has no current_version_id column: the current version is the highest version_number, which avoids a circular foreign key with report_versions
